info.name: CareRound - Alerts (Notification Service)
info.description:
Ward alerts in notification-service: an emergency declared in round-service becomes an Alert that realtime-service pushes to the ward's tablets. Covers replay (GET /wards/{wardId}/alerts), the admin unresolved-ward list, acknowledge + idempotency, wrong-ward 403, admin access and 404.
Set superAdminPassword in the environment. See postman/README.md.

exec: // Collection-level: (1) auto-login, (2) fail fast on unset ids.
// (1) Access tokens last 15 min. Any role whose email + password are in the environment gets a fresh
//     token when its current one is missing or expires within 60 s, so long runs never hit 401s.
if (isLoginRequest) return;                              // the request itself logs in
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ identifier: email, password: password }) }
else console.warn('Auto-login failed for ' + role + ': ' + (err || res.code));
// (2) Stale or missing ids used to be sent as UUID "null". Stop with a clear message instead.
if (name.endsWith('AccessToken')) return;              // filled by the auto-login above
if (/[Kk]ey$/.test(name)) return;                      // idempotency keys: generated by the request's own pre-request script
throw new Error('{{' + name + '}} is not set. Run the request that captures it first (or set it in the environment).');
